subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Queen Victoria was taught economical habits by her governess at her early age. Though she was rich she could not spend the money abundantly. The princess had a fixed allowance for pocket money. She was not permitted to go beyond it. There were a lot of incidences occurred in her life. She wanted to live such way but her great governess taught her a good lesson. One example was also found in the passage. It was a great lesson for all. Thus any person can be a great economical person by following her.
